entry_76c7.note: The native entry copies 7927..792E to RAM F8..FF; the first dispatch is at RAM 00FC

pre_fetch_hook.condition: before LDX ,Y++ (use a bpset at PC=0x00FC)
pre_fetch_hook.y: address of the next node's token word (VM cursor)
pre_fetch_hook.w_at_y: token pointer for the next IL node
pre_fetch_hook.x: value left by the preceding handler/token; for the incoming dispatch it is the preceding token pointer+2, not the node address
pre_fetch_hook.u: data stack pointer; w@U top, w@(U+2) second, ...
pre_fetch_hook.fetch_semantics: copied bytes 7927..792E are 3420 3184 AEA1 6E91: F8 PSHS Y; FA LEAY ,X; FC LDX ,Y++ (X=w@Yold, Y=Yold+2); FE JMP [,X++] (PC=w@Xold, X=Xold+2)
pre_fetch_hook.resolution: nodeAddress = Y when w@Y equals the mapped token; operand span begins at Y+2; handler entry has Y=nodeAddress+2 and X=tokenPointer+2 (tokenPointer=w@node); successor is the next 00FC Y, not arithmetic on Y

handler_entries.x_at_entry: tokenPointer+2=795D (equals handler PC for self-pointing 795B; not node+2)
handler_entries.example: 9ED9 entry: Y=9EDB, X=795D, inline FF80 at 9EDB..9EDC
9EE5 entry: Y=9EE7, X=7931; PULS Y restores caller cursor

composite_entry_limit.dispatch: X=9ED9, PC=00F8; copied PSHS Y saves EBCC on S and LEAY ,X sets Y=9ED9
composite_entry_limit.warning: Do not generalize the primitive X=handler-PC equality to composite/body entries; X=tokenPointer+2 is the body address here
